study_name: Execution solver accuracy and local performance

timing.gc: timeit disables Python cyclic garbage collection within each timed batch

design.policy: Prespecified sizes, precision cases and timing procedure. Keep all timings. Calibrate loops to the same minimum batch duration; deterministic shuffled method order. No claims that timings reproduce byte-for-byte or that a finite-size fit proves asymptotic complexity.
design.memory: Report actual input-array storage bytes and RHS storage separately; not peak process RAM or native workspace.

environment.matrix_layout: Fortran-contiguous dense and band arrays; contiguous diagonal/RHS vectors

input_storage.memory_scope: Input representation only; excludes solver copies, workspace and process peak RAM
